meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能建立并持久跟踪一个长期目标:创建目标、查看状态、标记完成。标记完成前它会先把目标拆成具体交付物,逐条对照文件、命令输出和测试结果核对,拿不准就按未完成处理。
howto.when: 当你明确要求设定、继续或审查一个长期目标时触发,或已经存在活跃目标时接管。目标的暂停、恢复、清理由 /goal 命令控制。

say.text: 帮我建一个目标:把 pi-goal 扩展发布出去,预算 50000 token
say.note: 会调用 create_goal 建立长期目标

say.text: 看一下当前目标的状态
say.note: 返回目标的 objective 和状态

say.text: 这个目标可以完成了,先核对一遍
say.note: 先逐项对照证据,再标记完成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can create and persistently track a long-running goal: set it, inspect its status, and mark it complete. Before completing, it restates the goal as deliverables and checks files, command output, and test results; uncertainty counts as incomplete.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to set, continue, or audit a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists. Pausing, resuming, and clearing goals are handled by /goal commands.

say_en.text: Create a goal: ship the pi-goal extension, budget 50000 tokens
say_en.note: Calls create_goal to set the goal

say_en.text: Show me the current goal's status
This goal is done, audit it first
